_about: Shades of Mort'ton, the minigame (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Shades_of_Mort%27ton_(minigame)) after the quest (quests/ShadesOfMortton.Quest.js keeps the quest's own steps). Recorded: rsprox 232/03119 and 232/03118 (shades fought and burned, normal worlds), 227/01858 (the catacombs: the entrance, a bronze door and a bronze chest, a Leagues world whose mechanics match). The chests' loot is the Wiki's red-key tables (every colour uses them: the Wiki's per-colour rates weren't read).
_shade: Recorded (232/03119 [39]-[170]): a shadow rises into its shade, the same NPC, as it is hit or as it attacks (shade_rise), and sinks back to its shadow about 68 ticks after its last fight; its remains always drop (private 100 ticks, gone at 200).
_zealot: Wiki (Undead Zealot, Altar (Shade Catacombs)): opening any chest raises an Undead Zealot 1 time in 20 (Mod Ash), attackable only by the opener; it always drops bleached bones, which restore full Prayer, without experience, on the Altar of the Damned. No rsprox capture exists (NPC 10591/10592 return nothing). 10591 and 10592 are the page's two versions with identical data; which the game raises is not established.

catacombs._entrance: Recorded (227/01858 [15240]-[15242]): a key opens the hillside's wooden doors (not used up), the doors swing open, and 2 ticks on the player is inside.

chests._coins: Wiki: a roll in the metal's range; coins are (roll - the loot's value) / 3 when the loot is worth less. Swamp paste always comes on top.

_messages: Recorded: logsOn, remainsOn, lighting, keyUnlock, needKey, tombDoor, tombDoorBack, wrongKey, treasure, swampPaste. Mine: noTreasureCoins (the recording always had coins), noRoom, noTinderbox, firemaking, weakLogs, pyreBusy. The quest's: needQuest.

_pyres: Recorded (227/01846 [10247]-[10272], 232/03118): pyre logs on the funeral pyre ('You put some logs on the pyre.', the pyre shows its wood), remains on the logs ('You place the shade's remains on the logs.'), Light ('You attempt to light the funeral pyre.'), the fire 3 ticks on with the experience, the Shade Spirit 2 ticks later, and 4 ticks after that the reward on the stone stand (private, gone after 500 ticks) with a puff of smoke as the pyre empties. Wiki: the woods (Firemaking level and experience), the remains' Prayer experience and the wood each needs, 21% coins or else a key.
